title: Bound activation ledger aggregate identifiers without rekeying durable rows
description:
Objective: close the activation ledger/store contract mismatch discovered while task-8e3076177f87458f934a776eca68ba16 was hardening a sibling aggregate derivation. Fresh committed measurement at HEAD 5e724768: `@moe/runner.parseEffectIntent` accepts both `aggregateId` and `idempotencyKey` through `isRef`, whose public maximum is 400 normalized characters; `deriveActivationAggregateId` in `apps/daemon/src/activation/activation-ledger-contracts.ts:242-243` length-frames both values verbatim. Two 400-character ASCII refs therefore derive an 843-byte identifier, and normalized multibyte refs derive 2,043 bytes, while the real `@moe/store` `requireIdentifier` ceiling is 512 UTF-8 bytes and rejects with STORE_INPUT_INVALID. The current fixture pair derives 69 bytes and may already name durable rows.

Deliverable: keep the exact legacy length-framed identifier for every pair whose existing derived bytes already fit the store contract, but use a versioned `sha256:` fallback over the full domain-separated, length-framed legacy preimage when it would exceed the 512-byte ceiling. This makes runner-admitted maximum refs commit through the production activation ledger without silently rekeying already-storable rows. Prove it through a new focused test that uses public `parseEffectIntent`, production `deriveActivationAggregateId` / `commitActivationLedgerRecord`, and a real file-backed `SqliteEventStore`, including ASCII and multibyte maximums.

NOT in scope: changing runner ref limits, store identifier limits/schema, activation record bytes/digests, replay/scan behavior, or the active task-d92b1b15a5b048e49671ed34990fa4a1 files (`activation-ledger-commit.ts`, reader, or their existing tests). Owned paths: `apps/daemon/src/activation/activation-ledger-contracts.ts` and new `apps/daemon/src/activation/activation-ledger-aggregate-id.test.ts`. The existing `.js` bridge and all public symbol names remain unchanged. Verification: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, with a nonzero Vitest test count.
definitionOfDone: Short/store-valid inputs retain their exact pre-change legacy identifiers, including a literal pin for the current fixture pair, so already-addressable activation rows are not rekeyed.

Every overflow input derives a deterministic `moe-activation-ledger/1|aggregate|sha256:<64 lowercase hex>` identifier no longer than 512 UTF-8 bytes; the digest preimage includes the versioned namespace and length framing for both identity components, and one-field changes remain distinguishable.

A literal two-case sweep proves public `@moe/runner.parseEffectIntent` accepts maximum 400-character ASCII and normalized multibyte aggregate/idempotency refs, then production `commitActivationLedgerRecord` commits each through a real file-backed `SqliteEventStore`; reopening finds exactly one activation event at the returned derived identifier.

Focused tests pin the overflow/legacy case cardinalities and independently distinguish length-framed hashing from bare concatenation, so a generated sweep cannot pass with zero cases and a boundary-shift collision cannot pass.

Independent production mutations that restore the unbounded overflow identifier and that remove an identity component or its framing each turn a named production-surface test red; every mutation is confirmed applied and restored byte-exact by SHA-256.

Fresh `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` exits 0 with a nonzero test count, all existing activation-ledger tests remain green, and `activation-ledger-contracts.ts` remains at or below 250 physical lines.
taskRails: Preserve exact legacy output whenever the existing derived identifier is already within the real store's 512-byte contract; hash only the overflow branch. A global algorithm replacement that orphans existing addressable rows is forbidden.

Hash the complete versioned, length-framed preimage with a fixed `sha256:` marker. Do not hash a bare concatenation, truncate caller text, accept a caller-supplied digest, weaken runner validation, or raise the store limit.
Use public package roots and a real file-backed SqliteEventStore for the load-bearing acceptance; no fake store, reimplemented validator, new schema, or deep import proves this boundary.
TDD every behavior; generated cases assert literal positive counts, any refusal assertion pins exact code and layer, and mutation drills alter production rather than a test helper.

Touch and commit only the two owned paths. Do not edit task-d92b1b15a5b048e49671ed34990fa4a1's live commit/reader/test paths, preserve all foreign WIP, and keep the production file at or below 250 physical lines.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
Retain the current length-framed identifier verbatim whenever its UTF-8 encoding is at most the store's 512-byte identifier ceiling; hash only overflow. This is the selected compatibility-preserving approach.
Rejected hashing every identifier because it would rekey existing durable activation-ledger rows.
Rejected truncating either caller field, accepting a caller-supplied digest, or changing runner/store validation because those weaken identity or expand this task beyond the control point.
Rejected importing the store's private MAX_IDENTIFIER_UTF8_BYTES or deep-relative importing workspace sources; the store does not export that constant and this repository has no paths/project-reference escape hatch.
Rejected a test-side hash oracle that reimplements production behavior. Exact known SHA-256 vectors pin the production surface instead.

planningNotes.risks:
